# TwisterTools

> 100% free, fast, privacy-first, browser-native online utilities and tools.

TwisterTools is a developer-centric collection of 60+ online utilities and converters designed to execute entirely in the user's browser memory (RAM). By utilizing browser-side technologies like client-side JavaScript, WebAssembly, and native browser APIs (such as the Canvas API and Web Cryptography API), TwisterTools offers zero-latency operations without transmitting any user files, inputs, codes, or secrets to external servers.

## Core Value Proposition

- **100% Privacy & Security**: No databases tracking inputs, no server logs, and no external transmission of user data. Your sensitive files and information never leave your local machine.
- **Zero Server Uploads**: PDF documents, images, formatting strings, and passwords are compiled, compressed, and converted entirely in browser RAM.
- **Instant Client-Side Computation**: Execution speeds are bound only by the user's local hardware resources, removing the lag of network queueing and remote processing.
- **Always Free, No Registration**: Every single tool in all categories is fully accessible without subscriptions, time-limited trials, paywalls, or registrations.

## Category Hubs

### [Developer, Code & Web Engineering Tools](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/developer-tools)
Essential browser-based engineering utilities for tokenizing, formatting, minifying, validating, and converting code.
- **JSON Formatter, Validator & Viewer**: Validate, beautify, compact, and inspect JSON structures.
- **XML Formatter, Validator & Viewer**: Pretty-print, minify, and validate XML documents.
- **SQL Formatter & Query Beautifier**: Format and clean SQL queries with MySQL, PostgreSQL, Standard SQL, and T-SQL dialect support.
- **CSS/JS/HTML Formatters & Minifiers**: Lexical tokenization engines to shrink or format stylesheets, scripts, and markup.
- **Base64 / URL / HTML Entity Encoder & Decoder**: Symmetrical data encoders and decoders.
- **Diff Checker**: Symmetrical text comparison tool featuring unified/split views.
- **Regex Tester & Cheat Sheet**: Debug regular expressions in real-time with visual capturing groups.
- **Unix Timestamp Converter**: Bi-directional epoch-to-date translations with a live ticker.
- **Cron Expression Explainer**: Translate complex cron configurations into human-readable text.

### [Daily Essentials, Financial & Math Calculators](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/calculators)
Privacy-first mathematical tools and financial calculators to simulate investments and compute business metrics with multi-currency formatting.
- **Simple Interest & Loan Calculator**: Calculate periodic interest, total payout, and amortization.
- **Compound Interest & Growth Calculator**: Project capital appreciation over time with compound frequency.
- **Investment Calculator**: Analyze periodic contributions, rates of return, and final balances.
- **Sales Tax & Discount Calculators**: Compute VAT/sales tax components and promotional savings.
- **Percentage & Average Calculators**: Solve standard growth, distribution, mean, median, mode, and standard deviation tasks.
- **Age Calculator**: Determine exact age down to hours alongside milestones and birth countdowns.
- **Auto Loan & Monthly Payment Estimator** (/tools/calculators/auto-loan-calculator): Estimate auto loan monthly payments, trade-in tax deductions, dealer fees, and amortization.
- Retirement Savings & Nest Egg Planner (/tools/calculators/retirement-calculator): Project long-term compound savings, 401(k) matches, and safe retirement withdrawal income.
- Break-Even Point & Profitability Calculator (/tools/calculators/break-even-calculator)
- **Salary & Hourly Paycheck Converter** (`/tools/calculators/salary-calculator`): Real-time salary-to-hourly and net paycheck calculator.
- BMI & Body Composition Calculator (/tools/calculators/bmi-calculator)
- Calorie & Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE) Calculator (/tools/calculators/tdee-calculator)
- Body Fat Percentage & Lean Mass Calculator (/tools/calculators/body-fat-calculator)
- Water Intake & Daily Hydration Calculator (/tools/calculators/water-intake-calculator)
- Exponential Growth & Decay Calculator: Discrete & continuous exponential growth/decay, doubling time, half-life, and time series schedule calculations.
- GPA & Grade Point Average Calculator (/tools/calculators/gpa-calculator): Calculate term and cumulative GPA across 4.0, 4.3, and 5.0 weighted scales.
- Target Heart Rate Zone Calculator (/tools/calculators/heart-rate-calculator): Calculate personal target heart rate zones for fat loss, cardiovascular endurance, and athletic performance using Karvonen and Tanaka formulas.
- Macro Ratio & Flexible Dieting Calculator (/tools/calculators/macro-calculator): Calculate accurate protein, carb, and fat macro ratios for fat loss, lean muscle gain, or keto diets.
- Ovulation & Fertile Window Calculator (/tools/calculators/ovulation-calculator): Calculate estimated ovulation dates, fertile windows, next period, and pregnancy test schedules.
- **Fraction Calculator & Simplifier** (/tools/calculators/fraction-calculator): Perform addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of fractions with automatic simplification and step-by-step output.
- Ratio & Proportion Calculator: Solve proportions (solve for X), simplify ratios, scale multipliers, and partition total amounts.

### [Password Management & Security Utilities](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/password-tools)
Zero-exposure cryptographic tools to audit password complexity and generate entropy-rich credentials.
- **Strong Password & Passphrase Generator**: Generate cryptographically secure passwords and memorable multi-word passphrases using browser-native CSPRNG.
- **Password Strength Checker & Cracking Time Analyzer**: Audit password complexity and estimate dictionary crack time entirely inside the local browser sandbox.

### [Text Analysis, List Comparison & Editing Tools](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/text-tools)
Robust utilities to manipulate, compare, count, and format text strings or structured list arrays.
- **Case Converter**: Transform strings between UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case, camelCase, snake_case, and PascalCase.
- **Comma Separator & List Delimiter**: Convert row listings or CSV data into custom delimited arrays.
- **Word Counter & Text Analyzer** (/tools/text-tools/word-counter): Measure characters, words, sentences, reading times, and keyword densities.
- **Reverse Text Generator**: Mirror, flip, or reverse text arrays.
- **Small Text Generator**: Generate Unicode-styled fonts for social copy.
- **Word Combiner**: Perform cartesian product phrase combinations for marketing and domain generation.
- **Email Address Extractor & Scraper** (/tools/text-tools/email-extractor): Extract, clean, deduplicate, filter by domain, and sort email addresses from raw text, logs, or unstructured documents — 100% client-side.
- **Duplicate Line Remover & Deduplicator** (/tools/text-tools/duplicate-line-remover): Scrape and clean duplicate lines with browser-native precision.
- **Line Alphabetizer & Sort Suite** (/tools/text-tools/line-sorter): Client-side line sorting, natural numerical ordering, and deduplication tool.
- **Text Line Counter & Blank Line Stripper** (/tools/text-tools/line-counter): Count total lines, strip blank lines, deduplicate entries, trim whitespace, and sort text lists online in real-time.
- **Phone Number Extractor & Formatter** (/tools/text-tools/phone-number-extractor): Extract, deduplicate, and format phone numbers from raw text into E.164 or US national formats.
- **Bulk Multi-URL Opener & Launch Sandbox** (/tools/text-tools/url-opener): Open multiple URLs.
- **URL & Hyperlink Text Extractor** (/tools/text-tools/url-extractor): Extract URLs from text.
- Text Replace & Pattern Substitution Tool: Client-side string replacement and Regex substitution engine.
- [Slugify & URL Slug Generator](https://twistertools.com/tools/text-tools/slug-generator): Client-side tool to convert headlines into web-safe SEO permalinks.
- Morse Code Translator & Audio Synthesizer: Real-time text-to-Morse and Morse-to-text converter with Web Audio tone playback.
- NATO Phonetic Converter: Real-time text to ICAO/NATO phonetic alphabet converter with Web Speech audio playback and phonetic guides.
- Strikethrough & Underline Font Styler (/tools/text-tools/strikethrough-text-generator): Generate Unicode strikethrough and underline text.

### [Image Editing, Compression & Conversion Tools](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/image-tools)
Lossy and lossless graphic asset optimization performing pixel rendering directly in browser memory.
- **Vector SVG Converter & Rasterizer**: Transform SVG vectors to raster PNG/JPG/WebP formats.
- **PNG to JPG & Format Converter Suite**: Batch convert graphic files between major formats.
- **Image Compressor**: Shrink image byte sizes using dynamic canvas-based compression ratios.
- **Image Resizer**: Scale width/height pixel dimensions with aspect ratio preservation.
- **HEIC to JPG Converter**: Decrypt and convert Apple HEIC photos to standard JPEG files locally.
- **Favicon Generator**: Bundle multiple dimensions into standard ICO files.

### [SEO, Domain & Network Inspector Tools](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/web-tools)
Privacy-respecting diagnostics to analyze domains, crawl tags, inspect DNS tables, and verify web protocols.
- **XML Sitemap Generator**: Client-side sitemap crawler conforming to Sitemaps.org standards.
- **Meta Tag Generator & Social Previewer**: Draft SEO titles, descriptions, and preview search/social cards.
- **Domain Age & WHOIS Checker**: Determine domain registration timestamps with native socket APIs and RDAP failovers.
- **What Is My IP & Network Inspector**: Fetch ISP geolocation, browser headers, and evaluate TOR/VPN/Proxy exposure.
- **DNS Record Finder**: Query A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA records using secure DNS-over-HTTPS.
- **SSL Certificate Checker**: Check SSL expiry, issuer, algorithms, and chains.
- **HTTP Headers Inspector**: Analyze response codes, security flags, and CORS parameters.

### [PDF & Document Utilities](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/pdf-tools)
Client-side PDF document manipulation engines running in browser memory with zero server uploads.
- **PDF Compilers**: Symmetrical image-to-PDF, PNG-to-PDF, JPG-to-PDF, and Text-to-PDF converters.
- **PDF Extractors**: Convert PDF structures back to Word documents, plain text, Markdown, or extract raster assets.
- **PDF Split & Merge**: Combine multiple documents or slice and extract specific pages.
- **PDF Grayscale & Watermark**: Convert pages to black-and-white or stamp text/image watermarks.
- **PDF Lock & Unlock**: Encrypt PDF documents with passwords or decrypt password protections.
- **PDF Page Numbers & Stampers**: Add running headers, footers, margins, and rotate/crop orientations.

### [Random Data, Identity & Key Generators](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/generator-tools)
Utilities for generating mock datasets, random credentials, and styled indicators with cryptographic precision.
- **Custom QR Code Generator**: Build stylized vector QR codes with embedded custom brand logos.
- **Bulk UUID/GUID Generator**: Generate bulk v1/v4 UUID strings using secure browser randomizers.
- **Mock Identity & Test Credit Card Generator**: Generate non-live test payment cards and synthetic persona profiles for software testing.

### [Data & Number Base Converter Utilities](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/converter-tools)
Symmetrical encoders and decoders for computing byte size differences and base number conversions.
- **Number Base Converter**: Shift digits between decimal, binary, octal, hexadecimal, and custom bases.
- **String to Hex / Hex to String Converter**: Translate standard text strings to hexadecimal representations.
- **Byte Converter**: Convert data capacities across bits, bytes, KB, MB, GB, and TB.

### [Date, Time & Scheduling Tools](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/date-tools)
Fast, precise, and privacy-first utilities for calculating date differences, timezone conversions, workdays, countdowns, and schedule planning.
- **Days Between Dates & Span Calculator** (`/tools/date-tools/days-between-dates`): Calculate exact days between dates, working business days, total weeks, and perform date addition or subtraction.
- [Time Duration & Hour Counter](/tools/date-tools/time-duration-calculator): Calculate exact days between dates, business days, and perform date arithmetic.
- [World Clock & Timezone Converter Matrix](/tools/date-tools/timezone-converter): Convert live and scheduled time across multiple international time zones simultaneously.
- Week Number Calculator (ISO-8601): Calculate ISO-8601 week numbers, week date ranges, and annual week metrics.
- [Event Countdown Timer Generator](/tools/date-tools/countdown-timer-generator): Create customizable, embeddable countdown timers for launches, sales, and events.
- Sunrise & Sunset Time Estimator (/tools/date-tools/sunrise-sunset-calculator): Calculate accurate sunrise, sunset, twilight phases, golden hour, and daylight duration for any coordinates.
- [Moon Phase Calendar & Visualizer](/tools/date-tools/moon-phase-calculator): Calculate accurate lunar phases, illumination percentages, moon age, distance, and monthly lunar calendar views.
